DECLARE
 temp_buffer VARCHAR2(9);
 v_local_time date;
BEGIN
 /* -- new tz function
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_time);
 ELSE
 v_local_time := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 -- END of change
 */
 
 v_local_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE); -- new tz function
 temp_buffer := :s_contract_id;

 SELECT company 
 INTO :s_company 
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_id = temp_buffer
 AND contract_type = 'RG'
 --AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id /* ModIFied by HCL CONSULTING */ SOUKUM/06012018/MLT-261
 AND LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(temp_buffer, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' 
 AND v_local_time BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10); -- Changed "SYSDATE" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 NEXT_ITEM;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT contract_id
 , company 
 INTO :s_contract_id
 , :s_company
 FROM contracts
 WHERE company = temp_buffer AND 
 contract_type = 'RG' AND 
 --chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id AND /* ModIFied by HCL CONSULTING */ SOUKUM/06012018/MLT-260
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND
 v_local_time BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10) -- Changed "SYSDATE" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT contract_id
 , company 
 INTO :s_contract_id
 , :s_company
 FROM contracts
 WHERE UPPER(company) LIKE ('%'||temp_buffer || '%') AND 
 v_local_time BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10) AND -- Changed "SYSDATE" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 --chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id AND /* ModIFied by HCL CONSULTING */ SOUKUM/06012018/MLT-260
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND
 contract_type = 'RG'
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 :s_contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_company := NULL;
 LIST_VALUES;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 --show_error('5150'); -- Commented by Kishore on 02/23/2012. IM 6962
 show_error('1147'); -- Added by Kishore on 02/23/2012. IM 6962
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 :s_contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_company := NULL;
 LIST_VALUES;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
END;

 IF :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK = 'UNITS' THEN

 lv_orderBy := 'coll_date DESC, batch_id desc, unit_id desc';

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('UNITS', ORDER_BY, lv_orderBy);

 ,pl_out_flag OUT VARCHAR2

PROCEDURE check_repeat_counts
 (
 pl_unit_id IN VARCHAR2
 ,pl_out_flag OUT VARCHAR2
 ) 
IS
 hold_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 szReac VARCHAR2(10);
 cUTRS VARCHAR2(10);
 nRepeat_ind NUMBER:=0;
 nReact NUMBER:=0;
 nNonReact NUMBER:=0;
 a_test_id VARCHAR2(10);
 nIntRes NUMBER:=0;
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938

 CURSOR utrs_cur(vLdate IN DATE) 
 IS 
 SELECT DISTINCT unit_id
 ,test_id 
 FROM utrs 
 WHERE unit_id = pl_unit_id AND 
 cancel_flag IS NULL AND 
 chapter_id = :units.chapter_id AND -- MLT# 62D
 test_id IN 
 (
 SELECT test_id 
 FROM contract_tests 
 WHERE contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id AND 
 profile_set_id = :units.s_profile_set_id AND -- MLT# 62D
 stop_label_flag = 'Y' AND 
 vLdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10)
 )
 ;

BEGIN

 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 FOR Z_rec IN utrs_cur(v_local_date) 
 LOOP
 a_test_id:=Z_rec.test_id;

 --Check IF the test has a reactive result 
 BEGIN
 SELECT DISTINCT result_status_1 
 INTO szReac 
 FROM UTRS 
 WHERE unit_id = pl_unit_id AND 
 test_id = a_test_id AND 
 chapter_id = :units.chapter_id AND -- MLT# 62D 
 result_status_1 IS NOT NULL AND 
 cancel_flag IS NULL AND 
 result_status_1 IN 
 (
 SELECT code 
 FROM master_codes 
 WHERE code_type='REAC' AND
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10)
 )
 ;


 --Check how many repeats are required FROM the repeat indicator value FROM the valid_tes_results table 
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(NVL(number_of_repeats,0)) 
 INTO nRepeat_ind 
 FROM valid_test_results 
 WHERE test_id = a_test_id AND 
 result_status = szReac AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+1)
 ;
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;

 --Check how many repeats are in the UTRS table. The YTRS should contain nRepeat times, IF not givedo not reconcile

 SELECT NVL(COUNT(*),0) 
 INTO nReact 
 FROM utrs 
 WHERE unit_id = pl_unit_id AND 
 test_id = a_test_id AND 
 chapter_id = :units.chapter_id AND -- MLT# 62D 
 result_status_1 IS NOT NULL AND 
 cancel_flag IS NULL
 ;

 IF nRepeat_ind +1 !=nReact 
 THEN --one COUNT should be higher in the UTRS table FROM the repeative COUNTs(original tests + additional repeats)
 hold_flag:='Y';
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 hold_flag:='N';
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN 
 --IF there is no reactives there should be only one non reactive
 SELECT NVL(COUNT(*),0) 
 INTO nNonReact FROM utrs 
 WHERE unit_id = pl_unit_id AND 
 test_id = a_test_id AND 
 chapter_id = :units.chapter_id AND -- MLT# 62D 
 result_status_1 IS NOT NULL AND 
 cancel_flag IS NULL
 ;
 IF nNonReact = 1 
 THEN 
 hold_flag := 'N';
 ELSE
 SELECT NVL(COUNT(*),0) 
 INTO nIntRes 
 FROM RGT_INTERIM_RESULTS 
 WHERE contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id AND 
 unit_id = pl_unit_id AND 
 test_id = a_test_id AND 
 chapter_id = :units.chapter_id AND-- MLT# 62D
 result_code IS NOT NULL 
 ;
 IF nIntRes > 0 
 THEN 
 hold_flag := 'N';
 ELSE
 hold_flag := 'Y';
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN 
 hold_flag := 'Y';
 EXIT;
 END;

 END LOOP;
 
 pl_out_flag := hold_flag;
 --
EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
END ;

begin
 if :perform_commit = 'Y' then
 go_block('units');
 if not form_failure then
 
 go_record('1');
 loop
 --if :qc_test_date is not null then 
 if NVL(:qc_test_flag,'@') in ('Y','T') then -- MLT 612 (use qc test flag as qc test date is not updated for interim results scenario)
 update batch_inputs
 set results_qc_date = sysdate, results_qc_user = :banner.user_id
 where batch_id = :units.s_batch_id -- :batch_id -- MLT# 62E
 --chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and MLT# 62C
 and contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id
 and substr(batch_id, 8, 2) = 'RG'
 and results_qc_date is null;
 end if;

 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 
 end if;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 if form_success then
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
end;
